name: toc
title: Toc
description: The in-page Table of Contents. A long read needs a quiet map of its headings that shows where the reader is and lets them jump. On a wide layout it is a rail beside the text (`Toc`); on a narrow one it is a slim bar that names the current section and opens…
author: ofri-peretz <https://github.com/ofri-peretz>
docs:
## @interlace/toc

Installed to `components/ui/toc.tsx`.

```tsx
import { /* … */ } from '@/components/ui/toc';
```

Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/toc

Requires the `@interlace/interlace-base` CSS baseline (installed automatically as a registry dependency). For the Interlace look, also add `@interlace/theme`.
